description_en: Unbinds and deletes tags from a specified Bastionhost instance in batches
description_zh: 为指定堡垒机实例批量解绑并删除标签
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to query.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource.

The only valid value is INSTANCE, which indicates a Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。

唯一取值为INSTANCE，表示堡垒机实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags from the Bastionhost instance.

If TagKey.N is specified, the value of All can only be set to false, which deletes the specified tag.
If TagKey.N is not specified, setting All to true deletes all tags. Setting All to false does not delete any tags
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否删除堡垒机实例上的全部标签。

设置TagKey.N时，All的值只能设置为false，删除某个标签。
未设置TagKey.N时，All设置为true，删除所有的标签。All设置为false，不删除标签
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the Bastionhost instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

N的取值范围：1~20。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag key of the instance.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh:
实例的标签键。

N的取值范围：1~20
parameters.name: tag_key

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The China value is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
